seo.title: Join Seedlings Waiting List - Sunflower Creative Arts

sections.heading: Seedlings Application and Enrollment
sections.html:
The Seedlings and Little Seedlings Application and Enrollment period has ended for the 2018-2019 school year, if you would like to join the waiting list for the upcoming school year please let us know.

Seedlings is for ages 3-6. Children must be 3 years old by Sept. 1, 2018.
Little Seedlings is for ages 2-3. Children must be 2 years old by Sept. 1, 2018.
Children under these ages may be considered at the admission team’s discretion.

sections.heading: Attend an Introduction to Seedlings Meeting
sections.html:
Learn about Sunflower’s educational philosophy and tour our indoor and outdoorclassroom spaces. Must RSVP to attend. This meeting is for adults and babies in arms only.No older children, please.

The next Intro to Seedlings meetings will be March 13, 2018, 6:00–7:30 pm, and April. 16, 2018, 6:00–7:30 pm.

Sign up for an Intro to Seedlings Meeting

sections.heading: Attend a Seedlings Visiting Day with your child
sections.html:
Prospective Seedlings and their parents must attend the program as visitors for at least one day. This visit is important, as it will determine if the program meets everyone’s needs.

Visitor fee is $40 per visit and covers your child’s hands-on participation in the class.

Sign up for a Visiting Day

sections.heading: Complete Application and Pay Application Fee
sections.html: To join the waiting list you must complete the Seedlings online application and pay the $50 application fee (non-refundable).
